verification: All three full SHA-256 hashes equal downloaded official files; also identical in impacket_0_9_21.

helper.behavior: Field descriptors create getters, setters and properties through a metaclass; reads/writes supplied packet buffers; getattr is used only for repr. No eval, program execution, network I/O, filesystem writes or obfuscated payload.
helper.dependency_review: Fetched official impacket package initializer (NullHandler logging only), matching ImpactPacket, and official six 1.12.0 add_metaclass implementation (class dictionary copy and metaclass invocation). Other dependencies are standard library struct and functools. No dependency lock or installed dependency artifact is supplied.

ImpactPacket.behavior: PacketBuffer encodes integer/IP fields, computes Internet checksums. ProtocolLayer stores parent/child packet layers. ProtocolPacket serializes header/body/tail; Ethernet/VLAN, LinuxSLL, IPv4, TCP/UDP, ICMP/IGMP and ARP implement in-memory packet fields and options. IP fragments data into packet objects. Socket calls are only inet_aton/inet_ntoa; no socket construction, connect, send, receive or listener. Uncalled example builds and prints an Ethernet/ARP frame.
ImpactPacket.false_findings: BBBB unpacking is four IPv4 octets, not a SOCKS handshake; self.parent() resolves to ProtocolLayer.parent, not a process query; set_ip_address mutates a packet byte array, not a device.

hresult_errors.behavior: All 2928 module statements are assignments with ast.literal_eval-compatible RHS. ERROR_MESSAGES maps 2927 HRESULT numbers to symbolic names and messages; remaining assignments are integer constants. No imports, calls, functions, comprehensions, interpolation, network operations or executable decoding.
hresult_errors.url_review: Only URL literal is http://servername/isapibackend.dll inside an error example. Attempted fetch fails DNS; servername is a placeholder, with no code path fetching it.

source_label_explanation: Likely inherited from an intrusion-tool bundle or broad Impacket/dual-use signature. These are unchanged reusable library modules; error vocabulary also resembles credential, disk-wipe and lock-screen behavior. The external label alone supplies no hostile execution evidence.
relocation_review: Exact trait references updated. Removed duplicate import rules use engine-emitted imports. Directory consumers audited: Rust collect is collection materialization, not loop evidence; broad loop consumers should no longer infer loops from collect alone. Their script-only scopes are unaffected. The source tasking consumer intentionally loses collect-only loop evidence and gains actual Python range(len(...)) loop evidence.
controls: Positive, near-miss and combined catalog-plus-real-operation fixtures in cases.json; the Rust collection move makes room for the correctly relocated Python loop without increasing budgets.
